name: Higuera de la Sierra (Spain)
description: Green field with stripes of yellow and white along the upper and lower edges, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Higuera de la Sierra (a fig tree and a fig leaf on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Higuera de la Sierra; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Higuera de la Sierra arms — fig tree and fig leaf on yellow
